records.name: Al-Bustan Seeds of Culture
records.summary: An Arab arts and language group in Philadelphia. It runs after-school art and drumming for students, Arabic classes for kids and adults, and gallery shows on the second Thursday of each month.
records.what_you_do: Take an Arabic class, come to a gallery exhibition, volunteer through the group's volunteer page, or join arts programming for students.

schedule.text: Gallery exhibitions on the second Thursday of each month. Gallery hours Tuesday to Friday, 10 am to 6 pm.

cost.text: Not published on the pages read

first_step.how: Visit the gallery on a second Thursday, or email info@albustanseeds.org to ask about Arabic classes or volunteering
first_step.basis: Public exhibitions and a listed email and phone give a clear way to start

records.notes: The group's site has no dated news, so status is probably_active from the site and a 2026 Cultural Fund grantee listing. Gallery address is 310 Master St. Unit 2 in the contact section and 310 W Master St. in the exhibitions section. Remote Arabic courses are offered per the site.

records.name: The Philadelphia Suns
records.summary: A volunteer nonprofit in Chinatown that runs youth basketball and volleyball, a lion dance troupe, a tech team, scholarships and college visits.
records.what_you_do: Young people can take part in sports, lion dance and education programs. Volunteers help with athletic programs, community service, lion head repairs and leadership roles.

schedule.text: Lion dances at Lunar New Year parades in Chinatown in February, and performances booked year-round for events

cost.text: No fees listed. Funded by grants, fundraising and participant contributions.

first_step.how: Go to phillysuns.org/get-involved and use the Join or Volunteer link, or watch the lion dance at the Chinatown Lunar New Year parade
first_step.basis: Open to anyone according to the site, but the page gives no sign-up steps, age range or contact email

records.notes: The batch website (whyy.org) is a news site, not the group, so phillysuns.org is used instead. The WHYY article is dated 2026-02-15. The group's own home page shows no dated news, only a 2022 copyright. The donation email and the 1018 Winter Street mailing address were not recorded as contacts because they are for donations. Founded 1972 as a basketball club, per the site.
